en.headline: John Lee to unveil Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and Policy Address on 16 September
en.dek: The Chief Executive said the two documents would be released together so the public can see how the annual Policy Address implements the longer-term blueprint.
body: Chief Executive John Lee announced on Wednesday that the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region’s first economic and social development five-year plan (2026–2030) and the 2026 Policy Address will both be published on 16 September.

Speaking after a district visit in Sham Shui Po, Lee said the five-year plan is a forward-looking, strategic and directional document that sets the city’s economic and social development blueprint for the next five years. The Policy Address is the Chief Executive’s annual report on implementing that plan and on the year’s policy priorities in light of current conditions.

Lee said the simultaneous release would help the public understand the continuum between the two documents. He added that the Policy Address would set multiple indicators as annual milestones, and that subsequent Policy Addresses would adjust measures according to the international environment, economic outlook and latest developments. The plan and Policy Address will be presented at a LegCo sitting on 16 September, followed by a press conference, a television forum and a LegCo question-and-answer session the next day.

zh.headline: 李家超：9月16日公布首份五年規劃及施政報告
zh.dek: 行政長官表示兩份文件同日發表，方便市民理解五年規劃與年度施政的一脈相承關係。
body: 行政長官李家超星期三宣布，將於9月16日公布香港特別行政區經濟和社會發展第一個五年規劃（2026–2030），並隨之發表2026年《施政報告》。
李家超在深水埗落區後見記者時表示，五年規劃是前瞻性、策略性和方向性的指導文件，訂下香港未來五年經濟和社會發展藍圖；《施政報告》則是行政長官落實五年規劃的年度報告，以及因應實際情況的年度施政重點，兩者息息相關。
他指同日公布是為了讓市民更容易了解兩者一脈相承的關係。李家超會在《施政報告》訂下多項指標作為年度里程碑，之後每年的《施政報告》會因應國際環境、經濟預期和最新動態制定該年的政策措施。9月16日將在立法會公布五年規劃並發表《施政報告》，同日下午舉行記者會，傍晚出席電視論壇，翌日再出席立法會答問會。
